svg.text: Source: ZZY / GSM8K, MATH500, MMLU-Pro; 2400 anonymous responses / 600 questions.
Boxes: Q1-Q3; median line; whiskers within 1.5 IQR. Outliers omitted. Current chart viewport retained.
